description: Create a Spanish travel vocabulary reference document. Open a new document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/spanish_vocab_reference.docx. Create four organized sections with headings: 'Restaurants & Dining', 'Hotels & Accommodation', 'Directions & Transportation', and 'Emergencies & Help'. In each section, add relevant Spanish-English vocabulary pairs (e.g., 'Una mesa para dos - A table for two'). Apply bold formatting (Ctrl+B) to the most essential phrases (at least 2-3 per section) for quick reference. Include at least 15-20 total vocabulary items across all sections. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
